svg.aria-label: Featured projects: Tumbli: A floating water buddy for Windows: a little bottle with a face that docks at the screen edge, fills up as you drink and reminds you to take a break.; iQueue: Queue-management platform for campus offices: a student mobile app, an admin portal and a live display board.; L.I.S.A.: Irrigation Survey & Analysis System for BISU Bilar: farmer surveys on a map, reports and AI-generated analysis.; Dagohoy Pharmacy: Point-of-sale and pharmacy operations workspace with role-based screens for owners, admins and cashiers.
